Arc devbar

Drag this button to your bookmarks bar:

Arc devbar

Then open any Arc XP (Fusion) page and click the bookmark. Click again or press Esc to close.

Shows deployment, arcSite, outputType, environment, globalContent (tree + copy JSON), globalContentConfig, features from Fusion.tree and quick links. Reads the page only, makes no requests.

Manual install (copy the code into a new bookmark URL)

Bookmarklet size: 39783 bytes. Built 2026-11-19.
